title: Length Bound for a Stored Row Prefix
statement: Let $l,W$ be natural numbers and let $w$ assign a Boolean word of length at most $W$ to each coordinate in $\mathrm{Fin}(l)$. For every natural number $j$, the stored row prefix of length $j$ has length at most $j(2W+2)$.
hypotheses_covered: family $w$ of Boolean words indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(l)$
each word $w(i)$ has length at most $W$
replaced: For counter words of length at most $W$ and every count $j$, the stored row prefix of the first $j$ fields has length at most $j(2W + 2)$: each field costs its doubled bits plus the two separator bits, independently of the native copying runtime.
